title: pvVisItVASPOUTCARReader
body:
## pvVisItVASPOUTCARReader

Reads VASP (Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package) OUTCAR files (names starting with OUT): every ionic step becomes a time step of a point mesh of atoms with element and force components, plus the unit cell. Use pvVisItVASPPOSCARReader for a single structure and pvVisItVASPCHGCARReader for charge densities. One file supplies every time step the format stores.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Forces arrive as separate scalar components; combine them with calculator to get vectors.
- Name the arrays you need in PointArrays and CellArrays: the VisIt bridge starts with every variable unselected, so omitting them normally gives geometry without fields.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue and has not run a native acceptance check for this reader; check meshes, arrays and times on your own data.

Native constructor: `VisItVASPOUTCARReader`. Identity: `sources/VisItVASPOUTCARReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrays` | Names of the zone-centred (cell) variables to read from VASP OUTCAR data; each becomes a cell-data array on every selected mesh that defines it. Vector variables arrive as one multi-component array, while VisIt expressions and tensor, label, species and array variables are not converted by the bridge. The VASP OUTCAR plugin declares its variables node-centred, so this list normally stays empty. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | Path of the single VASP OUTCAR file to read (OUT*); the reader takes every time step the format stores from it. Use an absolute path; relative paths are not resolved against the JSON file's folder (Studio uses the directory it was launched from). The file is usually named OUTCAR (no extension). Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Materials` | Names of materials to convert into volume-fraction cell arrays. For each selected material the bridge adds a float cell array named after it: 1 in cells made only of that material, its volume fraction in mixed cells and -1 where it is absent. The VASP OUTCAR plugin defines no materials, so this list has nothing to select. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Meshes` | Names of the VASP OUTCAR meshes to read. Each selected mesh becomes one named block of the multiblock output and unlisted meshes are skipped. The OUTCAR plugin reports the point mesh of atoms "mesh" and the unit-cell mesh "unitCell". | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrays` | Names of the node-centred (point) variables to read from VASP OUTCAR data; each becomes a point-data array on every selected mesh that defines it. Vector variables arrive as one multi-component array, while VisIt expressions and tensor, label, species and array variables are not converted by the bridge. For VASP OUTCAR data these are node-centred per-atom values such as "element" and force components "fx", "fy", "fz". | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvVisItVASPOUTCARReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
